% Invented text. Lines that open on a quotation mark or a T, inside a
% justified paragraph and as its last line: protrusion hangs the glyph
% into the margin on every line of a straight optical edge, or the edge steps.
\documentclass{article}
\fonts{ dir = "../corpus/fonts", body = "Source Serif Pro" }
\begin{document}
Plain first line of a justified paragraph that runs on long enough to wrap across the measure several times so that interior lines exist and protrusion matters here.\\
“Quoted” words begin this forced line, which continues long enough that it wraps onto another line of the paragraph and keeps going for a while.\\
“Quoted” short last line.

Tall Trees begin the next paragraph so that its first line starts with a capital T and it wraps to more than one line for the comparison of edges.\\
Tall Trees end it.
